name: Find Work Locations Website
overview: This python program creates a website for finding a work location in the town of Herndon.
details: The python program uses flask as the backend web framework and connects to a sqlite database for the main content. The website offers work locations in the town of Herndon, provided as a filterable and searchable list. Data on the work locations is stored in an SQlite database. The website allows users to add a new location using a form on the /search page, which adds the site details directly into the database and returns the user to a confirmation page. The website also allows a user to delete a location using two different methods. The user can either use the path /delete_site/<name of location> or use an api with method=delete call to delete the site by name.
